diagnosis: The GetVehicleTelemetry endpoint extracts vehicleId from gorilla/mux path variables and queries vehicle telemetry directly from the fleet service without asserting that the vehicle belongs to the authenticated fleet operator. An attacker with a valid operator account can track real-time locations and operational status of competitors' vehicles.
exploit_request:
GET /fleet/vehicles/veh-us-east-9912/telemetry HTTP/1.1
Host: fleet-ops.transport-cloud.io
Authorization: Bearer operator_token_774
Accept: application/json
